title: "mald"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_light())

library(brms)
```

## The data

The following is data from @tucker2019.
Loading the `.Rda` file attaches the data as `dat`.

```{r}
#| label: dat

load("data/tucker2019/MALD1_1_AllData.Rda")

dat <- as_tibble(dat)
dat
```

We do some data transformation for later.

```{r}
#| label: dat-transform

dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(
    RT_log = log(RT), PhonLev_log = log(PhonLev)
  )

dat_f <- dat |> 
  filter(RT > 0)
```

## Descriptive summaries and plots

```{r}
#| label: participants

dat |> 
  distinct(Subject) |> 
  count()

dat |> 
  count(IsWord) |> 
  mutate(prop = round(proportions(n) * 100))
```

Density plot of RTs for each participant and aggregated.

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens

dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red")

```

There are several RT = 0.

```{r}
#| label: rt-0

dat |> 
  filter(RT == 0) |> 
  count()
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-0-dens

dat |> 
  filter(RT != 0) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red")
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens-z

dat |> 
  filter(RT > 0) |> 
  group_by(Subject) |> 
  mutate(
    RT_z = (RT - mean(RT)) / sd(RT)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT_z)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red") +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.1)
```

Let's use the filtered data which drops all RTs that are 0 ms. We can get a few summary measures.

```{r}
#| label: dat-f-summaries

dat_f |> 
  group_by(IsWord) |> 
  summarise(
    mean(RT), median(RT), sd(RT), min(RT), max(RT)
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: rt-dens-isword

dat_f |> 
  group_by(Subject) |> 
  mutate(
    RT_z = (RT - mean(RT)) / sd(RT)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RT_z)) +
  geom_density(aes(group = Subject), colour = alpha("black", 0.1)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red") +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(vars(IsWord))
```


```{r}
#| label: rt-pl

dat_f |> 
  ggplot(aes(PhonLev_log, RT_log, colour = IsWord)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-pl-sample

set.seed(3175)
dat_f |> 
  slice_sample(n = 8000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(PhonLev_log, RT_log, colour = IsWord)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
